Helsingør is a Danish municipality evaluated in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database, published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) [^src1]. The report assesses clinical quality in atrial fibrillation treatment across all 98 Danish municipalities, utilizing data from the Danish National Patient Registry (LPR) and the Danish Stroke Registry (DanStroke) to benchmark local healthcare performance [^src1]. 

Helsingør's specific data regarding stroke (apopleksi) events among atrial fibrillation patients is incorporated into the DanStroke-based calculations for Indicator 5, which tracks the prevention of ischemic stroke via anticoagulation treatment [^src1]. In the report's detailed municipal breakdown, Helsingør is recorded with specific patient cohort metrics, including figures of 10 out of 1,703 and 9 out of 1,718, alongside associated rates and confidence intervals [^src1]. Because the available data is limited to this single tabular mention, no further historical, relational, or operational details about the municipality's broader healthcare infrastructure are documented in this corpus.
